test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "use."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The reason to use** "use"** in the blank is to emphasize the action or process of utilizing or making use of something. (रिक्त स्थान में** "use"** का उपयोग करने का कारण किसी चीज़ का उपयोग करने या उपयोग करने की क्रिया या प्रक्रिया पर जोर देना है।)
 
• **"Use"** highlights the active process of employing or making use of something, in this case, the preparation of power foods.
 
• Using **"use" **clarifies that the sentence is discussing the act of preparing and utilizing power foods effectively.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

Correct paragraph: 

Power foods are foods that provide rich__ levels of nutrients like fibre, potassium and minerals. With people becoming increasingly health conscious today, a lot of fitness trainers encourage their clients to include these foods in their daily diet to __increase__ muscle development. There are various ways of incorporating power foods in your daily diet. Of course, the key to enjoying power foods is proper preparation of these foods, the __**use**__ of season-fresh foods and identifying your choice of flavour among power foods. Some of the recommended power food combinations are those that are prepared in our kitchens on a regular basis. Take for instance, the combination of chickpeas and onions. This combination is a powerful source of iron which is required by the body to transport oxygen to its various parts. Iron ______ (4) ______ can lead to anaemia, fatigue, brain fog and tiredness. A study by the Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry says that sulphur compounds in onion and garlic help in the absorption of iron and zinc from chickpeas. The combination is a hit with teenagers who need to be ______ (5) ______ about getting iron in their diet. A quick way to prepare this power food is to make a chickpea salad with chopped onions, chaat masala and cilantro.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Yield: **the amount that is produced. (उपज, उत्‍पादन, पैदावार)
 
• **Apply: **to ask for something in writing. (लिखित माँग करना, आवेदन करना)
 
• **Handle: **a part of something that is used for holding or opening it. (मूठ, हत्‍था, हैंडल, किसी वस्‍तु का अंश जो उसे थामने या खोलने में प्रयुक्त होता है)
